environment.description: Same Spring Boot 3.1 application on ECS Fargate connecting to PostgreSQL 15 on RDS. The RDS instance uses IAM database authentication with a task role that maps to the pg_read_only predefined role via rds_iam. The PostgreSQL user 'app_secrets_ro' was created with: CREATE USER app_secrets_ro; GRANT rds_iam TO app_secrets_ro; GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_secrets_ro; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO app_secrets_ro; No additional DML privileges exist. The pg_hba.conf equivalent on RDS enforces that this user authenticates only via IAM token (no password fallback). The ECS task role has an inline policy with rds-db:connect scoped to this specific DB user ARN only.

config.database_grants: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_secrets_ro
config.network: internal ALB, security group allows 5432 from ECS tasks only
